description: Source code for the Raspberry Pi Pico clock control driver in Zephyr RTOS, including hardware initialization, clock configuration, and frequency calculation functions.

methods.name: rpi_pico_frequency_count
methods.description: Calculates the frequency of a specified clock source by reading hardware counters.

methods.name: rpi_pico_rosc_write
methods.description: Writes a value to the Rosc hardware register with status checks.

methods.name: rpi_pico_get_clock_src
methods.description: Retrieves the parent clock source for a given clock ID.

methods.name: rpi_pico_is_clock_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific clock is enabled.

methods.name: rpi_pico_calc_clock_freq
methods.description: Calculates the frequency of a clock by traversing the clock tree.

methods.name: rpi_pico_is_valid_clock_index
methods.description: Validates if a clock index is within range.

methods.name: clock_control_rpi_pico_get_status
methods.description: Returns the current status (on/off) of a clock.

methods.name: clock_control_rpi_pico_get_rate
methods.description: Retrieves the current rate (frequency) of a clock.

methods.name: rpi_pico_clkid_tuple_reorder_by_dependencies
methods.description: Reorders clock ID tuples based on dependencies.

methods.name: clock_control_rpi_pico_init
methods.description: Initializes the clock control hardware, configures PLLs, clocks, and Rosc.
